title: Docs: Mention MCP toolset placeholder behavior in mock mode
description:
We now allow Toolset "name" { use = "mcp.<server>" } to resolve to an empty placeholder toolset when TACTUS_MOCK_MODE=1 (so BDD agent mocks can run in CI without MCP server config).

Document this behavior so users understand why their mock-mode tests can pass without MCP, and so they know real-mode still requires .tac.yml MCP config.

Suggested files:
- docs/BDD_TESTING.md (Mocking section)
- docs/CONFIGURATION.md (MCP servers/toolsets)

Acceptance:
- Add a short, explicit note: mock mode creates placeholder MCP toolsets; real mode requires MCP server config.
- Include a minimal example snippet showing Toolset use = "mcp.filesystem" + tactus test --mock.
creator: Ryan Alyn Porter

custom.beads_close_reason: Documented MCP toolset placeholder behavior in mock mode
custom.beads_notes:
Outline / writing notes:

- Add a short note in docs/BDD_TESTING.md under mocking guidance:
  - In mock mode (tactus test --mock), Toolset "x" { use = "mcp.<server>" } resolves to an empty placeholder toolset so agent mocks can initialize without MCP.
  - Tool calls in agent mocks are recorded into ToolPrimitive directly, so assertions like 'the <tool> tool should be called' still work.
  - Real tool execution still requires MCP server config in .tac.yml.

- Add a short note in docs/CONFIGURATION.md near MCP server configuration:
  - mock mode does not start MCP servers; it only needs the toolset names to exist.

- Include a minimal snippet that references examples/61-mcp-toolset-by-server.tac as a concrete example.
